personality_one_liner: A soft, tactile, and joyful baby-blue and cream puzzle playground filled with bouncy interactions and cute memories.

spacing.rule: Use generous tactile padding. Cards and buttons should feel chunky and touchable. Never let elements touch screen edges directly.

do's: Use subtle brand-tinted backgrounds or solid cards. Playful personality favors solid tactile shapes over blur.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. Keep it soft, solid, and touchable.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: A joyful splash/landing screen welcoming the player to Ansh's Puzzle World.

states.loading: Centered soft pulsing baby-blue puzzle piece.

screens.layout: Safe area container. Large hero text 'Ansh's Puzzle World' in Fredoka (3xl) centered at the top. Below it, a playful 2x2 grid of floating baby photos acting as a decorative hero visual. At the bottom, a sticky, oversized pill-shaped 'Play Now' button in brandPrimary.

screens.name: Setup
screens.purpose: Allow the player to pick a photo, choose grid size, and select game mode.

states.error: Error fetching gallery photos, show a retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable setup flow. Section 1: 'Pick a Photo' - A horizontal scrollable row or a wrapped flex row showing the 5 built-in Ansh photos as rounded square cards (radius lg), plus one card at the start acting as the 'Pick from Gallery' button (brandTertiary surface with an Image/Camera icon). Selected photo gets a borderStrong highlight. Section 2: 'Difficulty' - A tactile segmented control or two large side-by-side cards for '3x3 (Easy)' and '4x4 (Hard)'. Section 3: 'Mode' - Two side-by-side cards for 'Relaxed' and 'Timed'. Sticky bottom container with 'Start Puzzle' button.

screens.name: Game
screens.purpose: The main puzzle gameplay board where players slide tiles.
screens.layout: Top Header: Back button (left), 'Moves: 0' (center), and Timer (right). The center of the screen contains the Puzzle Board: A fixed-aspect square container (surfaceSecondary, radius lg, subtle shadow). Inside, tiles are positioned absolutely with Reanimated layout transitions. Tiles must display segments of the selected image. Bottom: A 'Restart' or 'Shuffle' button in brandTertiary.

screens.name: WinCelebration
screens.purpose: Celebrate the completion of the puzzle with stats and confetti.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal or overlay. Background is a soft solid surface. A Lottie confetti animation plays automatically. Big 'Yay!' or 'Puzzle Solved!' text. Below, large tactile stat cards showing 'Moves Taken' and 'Time'. Bottom: 'Play Again' (brandPrimary) and 'Main Menu' (surfaceSecondary) buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'Tactile / Playful LIGHT' personality constraints: soft borders, pill buttons, heavy rounded typography (Fredoka), and generous padding. No sharp corners.

Do NOT use any blue/purple that resembles corporate tech (e.g. #007AFF). Use only the pastel baby-blues provided in the palette (brand: #AEC6CF, brandPrimary: #96B8C5) coupled with the deep ink (onBrandPrimary: #0A1F28) for high contrast readability.
Ensure 'Ansh's Puzzle World' uses the Fredoka font for the title. Nunito for all UI elements.

Photo Picker Setup: Provide the 5 built-in Unsplash URLs exactly as configured in the 'images' object. Add a dedicated 'Pick from Gallery' tile using expo-image-picker. The user's choice (either built-in or gallery URI) should be passed into the game screen route params.

Puzzle Board Mechanic: You must calculate tile dimensions mathematically based on container width minus padding. The tiles should just be 'expo-image' components that use absolute positioning and standard React Native overflow/masking techniques or a custom mapped crop (if supported). Alternatively, since cutting a native image into puzzle pieces is complex in pure React Native without native modules, consider using 'expo-image' with a specific 'contentPosition' and 'contentFit=cover' to simulate the cropped piece, or wrap the image in an absolutely positioned View with 'overflow: hidden' and translate the image inside it negatively.
Sliding Animation: Use react-native-reanimated for smooth 0.15s transitions when a tile's top/left values change.

Implement 'Relaxed' vs 'Timed' mode: Relaxed just counts Moves, or counts Time UP. Timed Mode should count Time DOWN from a reasonable difficulty baseline (e.g., 3 mins for 3x3, 5 mins for 4x4) and result in a 'Game Over' modal if it hits 0.
Celebrate: Include expo-haptics (notificationSuccess) and lottie-react-native confetti when the final tile slides into place.
Maintain WCAG AA readability: all text on the pastel surfaces must use the deep #2A3B45 or #0A1F28 colors.
Do not use generic UI emojis. Stick to Phosphor icons (filled/rounded variants match the playful vibe).
